name: booking-brief
title: Internal equipment booking brief
for_each: select id,code from bookings where status in ('requested','approved')

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,finding from v_compliance where subject_id=$1
sections.note: Booking status is not authority to operate machinery.

name: usage-statement
title: Internal usage estimate
for_each: select id,code from bookings where status='completed'

sections.title: Recorded session
sections.note: Internal estimate only. No tax, invoice, payment or accounting entry.

sections.title: Training evidence
sections.sql: select p.name,c.valid_from,c.valid_until,c.evidence,c.assessor,c.revoked from credentials c join people p on p.id=c.person_id where c.resource_id=$1
